en.name: Lunar Knight
en.ability: Each night*, if nobody died by execution today, you are woken to choose a player: if they are a Minion, they die.

revisions.v1: Each night*, if nobody died by execution today, you are woken to choose a player: if they are a Minion, they die.

en.otherNightReminder: If *WAKE TONIGHT* is in play, wake the Lunar Knight to choose a player. If they chose a Minion, mark that Minion *DEAD*.

zh.name: 月光骑士
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，如果当天无人死于处决，你会被唤醒并要选择一名玩家：如果他是爪牙，他死亡。
